badges.description: Promotional labels shown on the product card.

brand.description: Brand name when the feed carries one.

countryCode.description: Storefront code the record came from (US, UK, DE, ...).

currency.description: ISO currency code of the storefront.

images.description: Gallery image URLs when the feed provides them.

isOnSale.description: Whether SHEIN marks the product as on sale (home feed only).

position.description: 1-based position in that storefront's returned records (home-feed records come first in all mode).

priceUsd.description: SHEIN's USD equivalent of the sale price.

rating.description: Average customer rating when the product has reviews.

retailPrice.description: Retail (list) price in the local currency.

retailPriceText.description: Retail price formatted with the local currency symbol.

retailPriceUsd.description: SHEIN's USD equivalent of the retail price.

reviewCount.description: Number of customer reviews when available.

salePrice.description: Current sale price in the local currency.

salePriceText.description: Sale price formatted with the local currency symbol.

salesLabel.description: Sales label shown by SHEIN, e.g. 800+ sold.

scrapedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the scrape in ISO 8601 format.

soldCount.description: Units sold as shown on the card (home feed only); a 1.5k+ sold label becomes 1500.

title.description: Product name exactly as shown on the feed.

url.description: Product URL on the matching storefront. Uses the canonical slug when the feed provides one.
